title: Tay Pay
html_source: Thomas Power O'Connor known as T. P., was a journalist, an Irish nationalist political figure, and a Member of Parliament for nearly fifty years. O'Connor founded and was the first editor of several newspapers and journals: the Star (1887), the Weekly Sun (1891), the Sun (1893), M.A.P. and T.P.’s Weekly (1902). His nickname was “Tay Pay”.
